checks.name: initial
checks.coverage: 526889 cycles; all 1024 durations, terminal hold, active reload, consecutive loads, input changes between edges, positive-edge sampling and negative-edge stability

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation; official correctness is not established.
The literal single D flip-flop sentence conflicts with 10-bit timer storage; implemented one 10-bit clocked counter register according to explicit timer behavior.
Initial counter value is unspecified. RTL has no initialization or reset; testbench observes startup and checks functional behavior after loading a known value.
